subject: Ledgerly enablement: console + API scheduling
messages:
From: Kara Simmons <kara@ledgerly.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@ledgerly.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ledgerly enablement: console + API scheduling

Hi Vivek / Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Ledgerly would like to move forward with an enablement for our product and engineering teams. Our goals: a concise console walkthrough for product owners (~60–75 minutes) and a deeper API enablement for our backend engineers (90 minutes) that covers keys, batching recommendations, and the sandbox integration.

Proposed windows (we're PST): week of July 22 — any morning PT slot works best for our engineers. Attendees: Kara (PM), Tom (Eng lead), 3 backend engineers (may join for API portion only), and 2 product owners.

Can you share a couple of concrete slot options and any prerequisites we should complete (service account, API keys, sample data)? I've attached our security questionnaire in case you want to pre-read.

Thanks,
Kara Simmons
Head of Product, Ledgerly
Kara.Simmons@ledgerly.com

Attachment: Ledgerly_Security_Questions.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Kara Simmons <kara@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2029 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledgerly enablement: console + API scheduling

Kara —

Appreciate the clarity on goals. We can absolutely run a two-part enablement. Quick options from our side for the week of July 22 (all times PT):

- Tue Jul 23, 09:00–11:30 — Compact deep-dive (3h) split: 75m console, 90m API, 25m Q&A
- Wed Jul 24, 08:30–11:00 — Morning block (2.5h) with subsequent 45m APAC-friendly office hours (same day)
- Fri Jul 26, 10:00–12:00 — Two linked sessions (60m console + 60m API) with 30m buffer

If folks prefer two separate sessions on separate days we can do that too. For prerequisites: please create a service account with read-only access to the dev dataset (we'll send a short checklist), and include an engineer with GitHub access so we can push a small integration example into your sandbox.

I created a quick scheduling poll (link below). If you want us to hold a single half-day session we can also convert the morning block into a 3-hour "deep-dive + lab" and follow with an office hour next week.

Scheduling poll: https://doodle.example/ledgerly-redwood
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/HW-4821

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

P.S. Ben is on copy to help staff the API lab and run the sandbox prep.

From: Kara Simmons <kara@ledgerly.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@ledgerly.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jul 2029 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledgerly enablement: console + API scheduling

Thanks Vivek — quick note from our side: the eng team asked if we can condense this into a single morning half-day on Tue Jul 23 if possible (they prefer one travel window). Prefer 09:00–12:00 PT. They'd like the API hands-on to include a short sample integration with our message queue.

Also: Tom asked about environment access timing — can you confirm when the sandbox creds will be available and whether there's a short preflight checklist we should run a day before?

If 09:00–12:00 on Jul 23 works for you, we'll lock it.

Thanks,
Kara

Subject: Re: Ledgerly enablement: console + API scheduling

Kara / Tom —

We can accommodate the single morning block on Tue Jul 23, 09:00–12:00 PT. Proposed flow:

1) 09:00–10:15 — Console walkthrough (owner-focused; billing, team roles, monitoring)
2) 10:15–10:30 — Break / quick Q&A
3) 10:30–11:45 — API deep-dive and hands-on (keys, batching, sample integration)
4) 11:45–12:00 — Action items and next steps

Follow-up: we'll publish a 45-minute APAC-friendly office hours slot on Thu Jul 25 for questions and live debugging. I'll attach the enablement runbook and the calendar invite. Please confirm the attendee list and provide the GitHub repo or a sample message queue endpoint for the lab.

Attachments: enablement-runbook-v1.md, redwood-sandbox-invite.ics

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Customer Enablement Manager — Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Ledgerly enablement: console + API scheduling

Locked in for Tue Jul 23, 09:00–12:00 PT. Sandbox creds will be provisioned by EOD Jul 19 and I'll drop a short preflight checklist by Jul 22 (keys, sample dataset, test webhook).

Quick checklist preview:
- Create service account and send principal email to ben@redwood.com
- Add dev dataset read role to the service account
- Share sample queue endpoint (STAGING) or grant GitHub access to integration repo

I'll also include a short recorded demo (7m) of the console that you can forward to any execs who can't attend.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
